steps.title: You write a prompt
steps.body: A question or a task, typed in the chat.

steps.title: Copilot packs the context
steps.body: Your prompt goes in with everything else the model needs to see.

steps.title: The model reads tokens
steps.body: Text is split into small chunks. Every chunk counts towards the window and the bill.

steps.title: It writes a reply
steps.body: Or, as an agent, asks to use a tool: read a file, run a command.

steps.title: Results go back into the context
steps.body: Tool output and the reply join the history, and the next request carries them all.

request.tokensNote: Illustrative split: real tokenisers vary by model.
request.loop: Agent mode repeats steps 2 to 5 until the task is done

questions.question: Has the task changed?
questions.yesDetail: /clear, then carry over the decisions in a sentence or two.

lanes.label: When matching files are in play

memory.note: Always-on files ride along with every request, so keep them short. Specialist rules cost nothing until their files are in play.
